plugins.name: API Key Quota
plugins.description: Meters client API key usage and enforces per-key token, request and cost quotas with a built-in price table, model deny rules, per-key model mapping and fallback models, per-minute rate and concurrency limits with queueing, API key to account binding with per-account concurrency caps, time-window schedules with their own quotas, pause and resume, batch key management, and a bilingual management dashboard with usage charts.
plugins.author: minifun1218
